The '''Three Families war camp''' was a war camp that could be found on the poisonous [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Quesh]] operated by the [[Three Families]] during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of [[3643 BBY]] in the [[Time/Legends|time]] era known as the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Three Families War Camp}}</ref>

==History==
The camp was constructed in [[3643 BBY]] by the [[Three Families]] as a result of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]] attacking [[Quesh]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of high value to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] due to its valuable [[Venenit queshaaga]]. Shared by the Hutts and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], the camp quickly became operational with a full team of staff and supplies, with [[Broga Masrii|Broga]], the head of the organization, spending much of [[Gender/Legends|his]] time at the camp.<ref name="Codex" />
